title: Stream at Welch Ranch Landscape, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white mid-20th century snapshot showing a winding stream nestled within a tree-filled valley with a hillside backdrop. The back features a faint stamped number '093' and handwritten cursive reading 'Welch Ranch'. The print has classic deckle edges typical of 1940s and 1950s amateur photo prints.
